prompts.supina: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: landscape illustration for a caregiver web app posture reference card. Primary request: improve a simplistic pictogram into a polished, humane editorial medical illustration. One older adult with short silver hair, calm neutral face, wearing a modest muted teal short-sleeve pajama top and light blue pajama trousers, lying supine face up on a clean home-care bed with a white mattress and visible pale blue head pillow, comfortable natural human proportions, two arms resting relaxed alongside body and two straight legs, full body visible. Show a gentle three-quarter overhead view, head on left of image and feet to the right; anatomy and bed unambiguously recognizable. A soft supporting cushion near lower legs can be visible, as an orientative reference only. Style: refined hand-painted flat editorial illustration with crisp contours, subtle natural shading and fabric folds, not a stick figure, not 3D, not photorealistic. Palette coordinated with app: deep teal #0f766e, pale mint #e5f0ee background, slate blue #d7e7ef pillows, off-white bed, warm natural skin. Calm respectful adult-care feeling. Landscape approximately 1.7:1, generous quiet margin around complete bed, balanced composition, no cropped limbs. No text, no labels, no arrows, no lettering, no watermark, no logos, no medical devices. Educational reference, not diagnostic. Produce a single full landscape image suitable for a web asset.
prompts.lateral_izquierda: Use case: scientific-educational. Edit the supplied caregiver illustration into a LEFT lateral decubitus educational reference. Keep this exact illustration quality, respectful silver-haired older woman, modest teal pajama top and pale blue trousers, wooden home bed, pale mint setting, soft editorial watercolor shading. Change the woman from lying face up to lying on her anatomical LEFT side: LEFT shoulder and LEFT hip down on the mattress, right shoulder and right hip uppermost. Keep head at image LEFT and feet toward RIGHT. Her front/face should angle toward the viewer at the near long edge of the bed, shown naturally from a gentle three-quarter overhead camera. Body proportions realistic and comfortable, knees slightly bent rather than tightly curled, legs clearly separated by a visible light blue cushion BETWEEN KNEES, head rests on pale blue pillow, a supporting light blue pillow placed behind upper back. Both arms rest naturally in front, visible natural fingers, no trapped arm, no extra limbs. Full woman and whole bed in landscape frame, no cropped limbs. No text, labels, arrows, logos, watermark or medical devices. Keep image clean, calm, educational and visually consistent with the input. The scene is an orientative reference, not a prescriptive treatment diagram.
prompts.lateral_derecha: Use case: scientific-educational. Produce the RIGHT lateral decubitus companion image to the supplied LEFT lateral illustration. Create its horizontally mirrored anatomical/compositional counterpart: head and blue head pillow now at image RIGHT, feet toward LEFT, older woman lying on her anatomical RIGHT side with RIGHT shoulder and RIGHT hip down on mattress, LEFT shoulder and hip uppermost, face/front still visible toward the viewer at near long edge of bed. This is an opposite-side posture reference, not just a duplicate with identical bed orientation. Preserve the exact same silver-haired woman, same face/hair, muted teal pajama top, pale blue trousers, natural respectful proportions, wooden bed, off-white linens and pale mint backdrop, refined editorial hand-painted illustration and subtle shading. Keep slightly bent knees, an obvious cushion between the knees, support pillow behind upper back, head pillow supporting head. Exactly two arms and two legs, natural hands/feet, no cropped limbs. Head-right versus head-left should make the two references visibly distinguishable. Landscape same approximately 1.7:1 aspect, consistent margins and full bed framing. No labels, text, arrows, watermark, logos or medical devices; educational orientative scene only.
prompts.comodidad: Use case: scientific-educational. Transform supplied caregiver illustration into a companion illustration of comfort and preparation for care. Keep same gentle editorial illustration medium, silver-haired older woman, teal pajama clothing, light blue pillow, off-white mattress, wooden home bed, pale mint background, natural adult human proportions. Woman resting comfortably in bed with her full body modestly clothed. A calm adult caregiver in a muted blue-teal top stands beside the head/upper torso at the far side of bed, gently talking with the woman and holding a spare pillow at waist level, preparing support before any movement. Show listening, reassurance and preparation through natural eye contact and relaxed open gesture; do not depict lifting, pulling or physically repositioning the patient. Respectful contemporary educational illustration, refined shading and fabric folds, subtle setting without clutter. Landscape approximately 1.7:1, whole bed and both figures visible with margin, composition readable at thumbnail size. No text, labels, arrows, speech text, logos, watermark, medications or medical devices. Avoid extra people, extra limbs, dramatic scene or decorative clipart.

review_note: Los prompts laterales pedían una orientación anatómica incompatible con la composición descrita. Se asignaron las imágenes finales según el lado del paciente apoyado observado: izquierda con cabeza a la derecha del observador, derecha con cabeza a la izquierda, ambas con rostro hacia el observador. Sin editar ni reflejar bitmaps después de image_gen.
